_note: ASSUMPTIONS for the demo, not measurements or quotes. A real factory enters its own numbers here. Used for rupees at risk (scheduling) and the savings report.

_explain.unplanned_downtime_hours: hours a machine of this type stands still after an unplanned breakdown (finding a mechanic and parts, repair)
_explain.output_per_hour_inr: contribution lost per hour the factory's line is stopped
_explain.workers_idle: workers paid but idle while this machine is down
_explain.emergency_part_markup: extra paid for parts bought the same day vs planned (parts prices from parts_mock.json, also MOCK)
_explain.technician_rate_inr_per_hour: labour rate of a local mechanic or fitter (assumption, no published figure used)
_explain.usd_to_inr: RBI reference rate USD/INR on 2026-11-05, from MSEI's RBI reference-rate archive (https://www.msei.in/markets/Currency/Historical-Data/RBIReferenceRateArchives.aspx), accessed 2026-11-16. Used only to show Claude API cost per call in rupees.
